turns.customer: The delay on order #1055 ruined our camping trip. I want a 20% off coupon for my next order.
turns.reply:
I'm so sorry that the delay on order #1055 ruined your camping trip! 

Regarding your request for a 20% off coupon, our automatic system can issue up to 10% for delivery delays, so I've submitted your request for a 20% coupon to a team member for approval. You'll hear back once it's reviewed!
